fields.name: time_zone
fields.label: Time zone (for example Asia/Riyadh, Europe/London, UTC)

fields.name: min_password_length
fields.label: Shortest password (0 = as configured)
fields.description: Can only make the rule stricter than the server configuration: it never lowers it. 8 to 64.

fields.name: absolute_session_days
fields.label: Longest sign-in, in days (0 = as configured)
fields.description: Can only shorten what the server configuration allows. 1 to 90. Applies to new sign-ins.

fields.name: password_max_age_days
fields.label: Change passwords every (days, 0 = as configured)
fields.description: Can only make the rule stricter than the server configuration. 1 to 3650.

fields.name: default_language
fields.label: Default language code (for example en, ar)

validations.message: Use 0, or a number from 8 to 64.
Use 0, or a number from 1 to 90.
Use 0, or a number from 1 to 3650.
